verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://posthog.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. First-party docs also say each PostHog Endpoint exposes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec with request, response and auth schemas for typed SDK generation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the site-wide openapi.json and its coverage of the core PostHog REST API, and hands-on confirmation of the spec's completeness beyond the presence of the "openapi" key.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://posthog.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
The spec includes request schemas (with any variables your endpoint defines), response schemas, and authentication requirements.
Each endpoint exposes an OpenAPI 3.0 spec that you can use to generate typed SDK clients for your preferred language.
